episodeTitle.en: The playbook for building high talent density teams | Adam Ward, Head of Talent at Cursor
episodeTitle.zh: 如何打造高人才密度的团队｜Cursor 人才负责人 Adam Ward

guestBioOfficial.zh: Adam Ward 创办过独立招聘与人才战略公司 Growth by Design。Cursor 收购该公司后，他出任人才负责人。他关心创始人愿意为招聘投入多少时间，也关心候选人从第一次见面起经历了什么。
guestBioOfficial.en: Adam founded Growth by Design, a recruiting and talent strategy firm acquired by Cursor. As Cursor’s head of talent, he focuses on founders’ investment in recruiting and on the experience candidates have throughout the process.

title.en: The playbook for building high talent density teams | Adam Ward, Head of Talent at Cursor
title.zh: 如何打造高人才密度的团队｜Cursor 人才负责人 Adam Ward

summary.zh: Adam 把招聘拆成创始人亲自投入的时间、候选人沿途遇到的人，以及第一位招聘负责人究竟要解决的任务。一件贴合个人爱好的小礼物，也让他说明为什么争取人才早在发 offer 之前就开始了。
summary.en: Adam follows a hire from founder involvement to the offer, then turns to hiring the recruiter. A gift chosen for one candidate illustrates how much of the closing work happens well before compensation is discussed.

insights.title: 把招聘优先级对照日历检查
insights.detail: 创始人说人才排第一，Adam 就会追问：给了它多少时间和资源？如果什么都交给别人，这个优先级很难兑现。
insights.detailEn: Adam tests a founder’s stated hiring priority against the time and resources the founder personally commits.

insights.title: 接受 offer 的理由是一路积累的
insights.detail: 候选人见谁、团队何时了解其动机、疑虑有没有人接住，都影响最后的决定。重点候选人甚至值得团队每天用十分钟碰头。
insights.detailEn: Who a candidate meets and how concerns are handled shape acceptance throughout the process. A short daily check-in can help coordinate the team.

insights.title: 第一位招聘者面对的是两份工作
insights.detail: 填补已经积压的职位与从零搭建招聘体系需要不同能力。Adam 提醒创始人，开一个职位之前先说清眼下最急的是哪件事。
insights.detailEn: Clearing a backlog of openings and building a recruiting system call for different skills. Define which job comes first.

related.reason: 从组建招聘体系进一步看怎样面试和招到团队负责人。
related.reasonEn: How to assess and hire leaders once the recruiting process is in place.

title.en: Gokul Rajaram on designing your product development process, when and how to hire your first PM, a playbook for hiring leaders, getting ahead in you career, how to get started angel investing, more
title.zh: 戈库尔·拉贾拉姆将探讨如何设计产品开发流程、何时及如何聘请首位产品经理、招聘领导者的指南、职业发展、如何开启天使投资等诸多话题。
